summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K, a periodic report for foreign private issuers, containing a standard TR-1 notification of major holdings. The filing reports that Artisan Partners Limited Partnership crossed above the 5% threshold, holding 5.113% of voting rights as of May 29, 2026. This is a routine disclosure of a passive stake crossing, not a special situation event. No acquisition target, strategic review, or other special category is involved.
